summary: Serving openai/gpt-oss-20b on TPU with vLLM. A launch-time patch script for the vllm_torchtpu plugin, revision-tolerant across plugin layouts: the gpt_oss_mxfp4 quantization name, a config whose get_name() matches vLLM's fused-expert loader, zero-padding of the 2880-wide expert weights to 128 for gmm_v2, zeroing of the MoE-TP intermediate tail the loader never writes, the hd64 attention-sink fix, and the input_ids argument older vLLM passes. Validated serving settings (TP 8 x DP 1 with USE_MOE_SPARSE_CORE=0; TP 2 and TP 4 also pass; TP 1 has no device layout on vLLM 0.29.0), triage of each failure, the validated stacks, and known-good greedy outputs to verify the server.
note: Authored, not fetched: written from tpu-model-onboarding fix runs on vLLM 0.22.1 (2026-10-01) and vLLM 0.29.0 (2026-10-13), and from a TP sweep and a vLLM 0.22.1 re-run with the current script (2026-10-13), all on tpu7x 2x2x1.
